Distribution and natural history (Figure 29). Trico tricolor comb. n. is known to date from the Amazon basin, the Guianas and Trinidad. The nominate subspecies occurs in the Guianas and Trinidad, as well as along the Amazon river from the state of Maranhao ˜ to Manaus. The neighbouring subspecies Trico tricolor fulgora comb. n., occurs mainly in the western Amazon basin, but its range apparently extends as far south as central Bolivia and as far east as central Brazil. The immature stages and hostplants have not been described. A list of specimens examined is provided in Appendix B.
